correctness.rationale: For each input auxiliary graph, active next-step edges are exactly isolated-edge components plus every pair of isolated vertices. The remaining covered vertices are partitioned into components of size at least three; all possible images and two-cycle partners follow. Exact inverse-image graph counts give every basin; the formal graph EGF removes singleton and K2 components. Matching enumeration and a Bonferroni estimate prove the orbit counts and rare-defect law. Two separate implementations exhaustively checked 2^C(n,2) initial inputs for n<=6 and n<=7 respectively, comparing individual orbit basins, as documented in packaged output files. No extrapolation from finite tests was used as proof.

originality.rationale: published-finding corpus searches and inspected exact primary statements reveal no stronger claim covering the open-neighborhood L(K_n) matching-plus-clique orbit and individual-basin theorem. General F^3=F, maximal matching fixed states, and broad periodic-point methods are background. The closed-neighborhood L(K_n) result is not equivalent: it forbids self-survival, has no fixed points, and its leading exceptional-basin coefficient is one rather than two. L(K_{a,b}) rook and KG(n,2) cases have distinct adjacency, so no implication. The sharp matching-sensitive basin census and doubled rare-obstruction asymptotic are not in accessible compared results. Priority remains qualified by unindexed older work.
residual_risks: An unindexed historical explicit synchronous open NOR triangular-graph basin classification may exist under MIS, negative conjunctive, inhibition, or line-graph terminology.
The 2015 conjunctive-network preprint full text was not retrieved; abstract alone cannot certify its full contents.
The 2012 maxterm/minterm paper (DOI 10.1016/j.mcm.2011.08.040) was not read in full; possible specialized methods remain a priority risk.
Publication records and published-finding corpus search cannot establish global uniqueness.

value.rationale: The triangular graphs are a canonical infinite line-graph family, providing a natural test of how removing local self-inhibition changes recurrent geometry. The exact matching-skeleton attractor and every individual attraction basin constitute a complete parametric classification. The factor-of-two rare-obstruction law supplies a nontrivial comparison to the closed-neighborhood model, explaining the two independent minimal obstructions instead of merely computing a small finite table.
